children: DeepBook launches its all-in-one trading app worldwide, bringing a more powerful, simple, and accessible trading experience to users everywhere. The release consolidates the platform's trading functions into a single application and opens the product to a global retail audience.

The global rollout expands retail access to DeepBook, the platform whose activity underpins DEEP's value. Wider availability can raise protocol usage, and higher usage can translate into greater token demand as trading activity grows. The size of that effect depends on adoption, so early usage data after launch will indicate whether the worldwide release converts into sustained protocol growth.

title: DeepBook: All-in-One Trading App Goes Live Worldwide - 26 Sep 2026
